JOINT PROPOSAL addendum 2, 2026-10-25. Agreed on the storyatlas4s Fray board, card #136: messages @1043 (Codex proposal) and @1044 (Claude agreement). Not owner-decided policy. It supersedes the v1 scene-level split of op 20261025T144952.841248Z-p47815-c0000-r6988-hec6c12.

v2 split, frozen before any labels, outputs or binder work:
- Blocks: ten fixed blocks of five global scene ids (1-5 through 46-50), from source ordering only, not claimed to be story arcs.
- Assignment: block 26-30 (the body scenes) is forced into discovery. Each other block is ranked by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string identity-feasibility-NN03-20261025-v2:<start>, with <start> the block's first scene id in decimal without padding, sorted ascending. The first five go to confirmation, the other four to discovery. That gives confirmation blocks 1, 6, 11, 31 and 46.
- One seed: if the sample is insufficient, that is reported and no other seed is tried.
- Selection: whole blocks in seed order within each partition, body block first in discovery, until there are at least 15 distinct non-regression, non-quarantined human-resolvable natural decisions plus at least 2 hard natural decisions from at least 2 strata (off-screen; relational description; within-partition multi-scene; role, event, state or context disambiguation). Designed controls stay mandatory and separate. Absent strata are reported, and excluded and quarantined cases stay visible. Costs are budget limits, not a ranking.
- Block 26-30 crosses the media-part boundary (scenes 26-27 part a, 28-30 part b).
- The v1 census and seed are kept as superseded.
- Disclosure: before any labels or outputs, Claude computed the v2 assignment once at review request. As a metadata proxy, 6 of 32 adjacent pairs in NN03's recall order cross partitions, and confirmation holds 17 of the 32 recalled scenes and 1,403 of the 2,495 recall words. No seed was rejected.

Recorded in docs/plans/2026-10-25-identity-feasibility-inputs.md, section 4.2 item 2.
